name: RainichKaluza.monicQuartic_fromFactorization

name: RainichKaluza.exists_real_rankOne_completion_iff

theorem exists_real_rankOne_completion_iff (u v : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem exists_reconstructed_rankOne_completion_iff

    (∃ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 =
      reconstructedDiagonalA a b qSq *
        reconstructedDiagonalB a b qSq) ↔
      (a ^ 2 - qSq) * (b ^ 2 - qSq) ≤ 0

name: RainichKaluza.offDiagonal_eq_zero_of_nonresonant

theorem offDiagonal_eq_zero_of_nonresonant

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructedDiagonalA_solves
statement:
theorem reconstructedDiagonalA_solves
    (a b qSq : ℝ) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (2 * a - (a + b)) * reconstructedDiagonalA a b qSq =

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructedDiagonalB_solves
statement:
theorem reconstructedDiagonalB_solves
    (a b qSq : ℝ) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (2 * b - (a + b)) * reconstructedDiagonalB a b qSq =

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructedDiagonal_product
statement:
theorem reconstructedDiagonal_product
    (a b qSq : ℝ) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    reconstructedDiagonalA a b qSq *
      reconstructedDiagonalB a b qSq =
        -((a ^ 2 - qSq) * (b ^ 2 - qSq)) / (a - b) ^ 2

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructedDiagonal_sum
statement:
theorem reconstructedDiagonal_sum
    (a b qSq : ℝ) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    reconstructedDiagonalA a b qSq +
      reconstructedDiagonalB a b qSq = a + b

name: RainichKaluza.exists_scalarComplementaryBlock_iff
statement:
theorem exists_scalarComplementaryBlock_iff
    (a b qSq epsilonA epsilonB : ℝ)
    (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hepsilonA : epsilonA ^ 2 = 1)
    (hepsilonB : epsilonB ^ 2 = 1) :
    (∃ x y : ℝ,
      SolvesComplementaryBlock a b qSq
        (scalarMixedBlockOfComponents epsilonA epsilonB x y)) ↔
      0 ≤ epsilonA * reconstructedDiagonalA a b qSq ∧
      0 ≤ epsilonB * reconstructedDiagonalB a b qSq

name: RainichKaluza.exists_scalar_components_iff
statement:
theorem exists_scalar_components_iff
    (epsilonA epsilonB u v : ℝ)
    (hepsilonA : epsilonA ^ 2 = 1)
    (hepsilonB : epsilonB ^ 2 = 1) :
    (∃ x y : ℝ,
      u = scalarMixedDiagonal epsilonA x ∧
      v = scalarMixedDiagonal epsilonB y) ↔
      0 ≤ epsilonA * u ∧ 0 ≤ epsilonB * v

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructedBlock_has_scalar_factorization_iff
statement:
theorem reconstructedBlock_has_scalar_factorization_iff
    (a b qSq epsilonA epsilonB : ℝ)
    (hepsilonA : epsilonA ^ 2 = 1)
    (hepsilonB : epsilonB ^ 2 = 1) :
    (∃ x y : ℝ,
      reconstructedDiagonalA a b qSq =
        scalarMixedDiagonal epsilonA x ∧
      reconstructedDiagonalB a b qSq =
        scalarMixedDiagonal epsilonB y) ↔
      0 ≤ epsilonA * reconstructedDiagonalA a b qSq ∧
      0 ≤ epsilonB * reconstructedDiagonalB a b qSq

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructed_signature_unsigned_tests_incomparable
statement:
theorem reconstructed_signature_unsigned_tests_incomparable :
    ((0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * reconstructedDiagonalA 5 (-5) 5 ∧
        0 ≤ (-1 : ℝ) * reconstructedDiagonalB 5 (-5) 5) ∧
      ¬ 0 ≤ reconstructedDiagonalA 5 (-5) 5 *
        reconstructedDiagonalB 5 (-5) 5) ∧
    ((0 ≤ reconstructedDiagonalA 2 1 2 *
        reconstructedDiagonalB 2 1 2) ∧
      ¬ (0 ≤ (-1 : ℝ) * reconstructedDiagonalA 2 1 2 ∧
        0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * reconstructedDiagonalB 2 1 2))

name: RainichKaluza.scalarComplementarySolution_sqrtAmplitudes_eq_abs
statement:
theorem scalarComplementarySolution_sqrtAmplitudes_eq_abs
    (a b qSq epsilonA epsilonB x y : ℝ)
    (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hepsilonA : epsilonA ^ 2 = 1)
    (hepsilonB : epsilonB ^ 2 = 1)
    (hsolves : SolvesComplementaryBlock a b qSq
      (scalarMixedBlockOfComponents epsilonA epsilonB x y)) :
    Real.sqrt
        (2 * epsilonA * reconstructedDiagonalA a b qSq) = |x| ∧
      Real.sqrt
        (2 * epsilonB * reconstructedDiagonalB a b qSq) = |y|

name: RainichKaluza.scalarMixedBlock_components_unique_up_to_sign
statement:
theorem scalarMixedBlock_components_unique_up_to_sign
    (epsilonA epsilonB x y x' y' : ℝ)
    (hepsilonA : epsilonA ^ 2 = 1)
    (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hblock :
      scalarMixedBlockOfComponents epsilonA epsilonB x y =
        scalarMixedBlockOfComponents epsilonA epsilonB x' y') :
    (x' = x ∧ y' = y) ∨ (x' = -x ∧ y' = -y)

name: RainichKaluza.scalarMixedBlock_metric_selfAdjoint
statement:
theorem scalarMixedBlock_metric_selfAdjoint
    (epsilonA epsilonB x y : ℝ)
    (hepsilonA : epsilonA ^ 2 = 1)

name: RainichKaluza.scalarMixedBlock_rankOne
statement:
theorem scalarMixedBlock_rankOne
    (epsilonA epsilonB x y : ℝ) :
    scalarMixedDiagonal epsilonA x * scalarMixedDiagonal epsilonB y =
      scalarMixedOffDiagonal epsilonA x y *
        scalarMixedOffDiagonal epsilonB y x

name: RainichKaluza.solvesComplementaryBlock_iff
statement:
theorem solvesComplementaryBlock_iff
    (a b qSq : ℝ) (hab : a ≠ b) (block : MixedBlock) :
    SolvesComplementaryBlock a b qSq block ↔
      block.aa = reconstructedDiagonalA a b qSq ∧
      block.bb = reconstructedDiagonalB a b qSq

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructionEquation_conjugation_invariant
statement:
theorem reconstructionEquation_conjugation_invariant
    {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℝ A]
    (R V C : A) (traceV qSq : ℝ)
    (hC : C * C = 1)
    (hCR : C * R = R * C)
    (hV : R * V + V * R - traceV • V =
      R * R - qSq • (1 : A)) :
    R * (C * V * C) + (C * V * C) * R -
        traceV • (C * V * C) =
      R * R - qSq • (1 : A)

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructionEquation_of_decomposition
statement:
theorem reconstructionEquation_of_decomposition
    {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℝ A]
    (S V : A) (traceV qSq : ℝ)
    (hS : S * S = qSq • (1 : A))
    (hV : V * V = traceV • V) :
    let R := S + V
    R * V + V * R - traceV • V = R * R - qSq • (1 : A)

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructionEquation_of_eq_add
statement:
theorem reconstructionEquation_of_eq_add
    {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℝ A]
    (R S V : A) (traceV qSq : ℝ)
    (hR : R = S + V)
    (hS : S * S = qSq • (1 : A))
    (hV : V * V = traceV • V) :
    R * V + V * R - traceV • V = R * R - qSq • (1 : A)

theorem maxwellResidual_add_scalar (R V : A) :

name: RainichKaluza.maxwellResidual_sq_of_reconstructionEquation
statement:
theorem maxwellResidual_sq_of_reconstructionEquation
    (R V : A) (traceV qSq : ℝ)

    (hrecon : R * V + V * R - traceV • V =
      R * R - qSq • (1 : A)) :
    maxwellResidual R V * maxwellResidual R V = qSq • (1 : A)

name: RainichKaluza.maxwellResidual_trace_zero

theorem maxwellResidual_trace_zero
    (trace : A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (R V : A) (traceV : ℝ)

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructionEquation_iff_maxwellResidual_sq

name: RainichKaluza.maxwellMinusProjector_sq

name: RainichKaluza.maxwellPlusProjector_sq

name: RainichKaluza.DualityParameter.ext

name: RainichKaluza.canonicalMaxwellMagnitude_duality
statement:
theorem canonicalMaxwellMagnitude_duality
    (p : DualityParameter) (E B : ℝ) :
    canonicalMaxwellMagnitude (dualityElectric p E B)
      (dualityMagnetic p E B) = canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E B

name: RainichKaluza.dualityBetween_electric
statement:
theorem dualityBetween_electric
    (E B E' B' : ℝ)
    (hmag : canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E B ≠ 0) :
    dualityCosineBetween E B E' B' * E -
      dualitySineBetween E B E' B' * B = E'

name: RainichKaluza.dualityBetween_magnetic
statement:
theorem dualityBetween_magnetic
    (E B E' B' : ℝ)
    (hmag : canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E B ≠ 0) :
    dualitySineBetween E B E' B' * E +
      dualityCosineBetween E B E' B' * B = B'

name: RainichKaluza.dualityBetween_unit
statement:
theorem dualityBetween_unit
    (E B E' B' : ℝ)
    (hmag : canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E B ≠ 0)
    (heq : canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E' B' =
      canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E B) :
    dualityCosineBetween E B E' B' ^ 2 +
      dualitySineBetween E B E' B' ^ 2 = 1

name: RainichKaluza.dualityCompose_assoc
statement:
theorem dualityCompose_assoc (p r t : DualityParameter) :

name: RainichKaluza.dualityCompose_identity_left
statement:
theorem dualityCompose_identity_left (p : DualityParameter) :
    dualityCompose dualityIdentity p = p

name: RainichKaluza.dualityCompose_identity_right
statement:
theorem dualityCompose_identity_right (p : DualityParameter) :

name: RainichKaluza.dualityCompose_inverse_left

name: RainichKaluza.dualityElectric_compose
statement:
theorem dualityElectric_compose
    (p r : DualityParameter) (E B : ℝ) :
    dualityElectric p (dualityElectric r E B) (dualityMagnetic r E B) =
      dualityElectric (dualityCompose p r) E B

name: RainichKaluza.dualityMagnetic_compose
statement:
theorem dualityMagnetic_compose
    (p r : DualityParameter) (E B : ℝ) :
    dualityMagnetic p (dualityElectric r E B) (dualityMagnetic r E B) =
      dualityMagnetic (dualityCompose p r) E B

name: RainichKaluza.dualityParameter_unique
statement:
theorem dualityParameter_unique
    (p r : DualityParameter) (E B : ℝ)
    (hmag : canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E B ≠ 0)
    (hE : dualityElectric p E B = dualityElectric r E B)
    (hB : dualityMagnetic p E B = dualityMagnetic r E B) :

name: RainichKaluza.duality_overlap_cocycle
statement:
theorem duality_overlap_cocycle
    (p r : DualityParameter) (E B E' B' E'' B'' : ℝ)
    (hrE : dualityElectric r E B = E')
    (hrB : dualityMagnetic r E B = B')
    (hpE : dualityElectric p E' B' = E'')
    (hpB : dualityMagnetic p E' B' = B'') :
    dualityElectric (dualityCompose p r) E B = E'' ∧
      dualityMagnetic (dualityCompose p r) E B = B''

name: RainichKaluza.exists_dualityParameter_iff_same_magnitude
statement:
theorem exists_dualityParameter_iff_same_magnitude
    (E B E' B' : ℝ) (hmag : canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E B ≠ 0) :
    (∃ p : DualityParameter,
      dualityElectric p E B = E' ∧ dualityMagnetic p E B = B') ↔
      canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E' B' = canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E B

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRate_constant_duality_invariant
statement:
theorem complexionRate_constant_duality_invariant
    (p : DualityParameter) (c s dc ds : ℝ) :
    complexionRate (dualityElectric p c s) (dualityMagnetic p c s)
        (dualityElectric p dc ds) (dualityMagnetic p dc ds) =
      complexionRate c s dc ds

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRate_dualityComposeDerivative
statement:
theorem complexionRate_dualityComposeDerivative
    (p r : DualityParameter) (dpc dps drc drs : ℝ) :
    complexionRate (dualityCompose p r).c (dualityCompose p r).s
        (dualityComposeCDerivative p r dpc dps drc drs)
        (dualityComposeSDerivative p r dpc dps drc drs) =
      complexionRate p.c p.s dpc dps +
        complexionRate r.c r.s drc drs

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRate_dualityInverseDerivative
statement:
theorem complexionRate_dualityInverseDerivative
    (p : DualityParameter) (dc ds : ℝ) :
    complexionRate (dualityInverse p).c (dualityInverse p).s dc (-ds) =
      -complexionRate p.c p.s dc ds

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRate_unique
statement:
theorem complexionRate_unique
    (c s dc ds omega : ℝ)
    (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hdc : dc = -omega * s) (hds : ds = omega * c) :
    omega = complexionRate c s dc ds

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRate_variable_duality_add
statement:
theorem complexionRate_variable_duality_add
    (p r : DualityParameter) (du dv dc ds : ℝ) :
    complexionRate (dualityElectric p r.c r.s)
        (dualityMagnetic p r.c r.s)
        (variableDualityElectricDerivative p.c p.s du dv r.c r.s dc ds)
        (variableDualityMagneticDerivative p.c p.s du dv r.c r.s dc ds) =
      complexionRate r.c r.s dc ds + complexionRate p.c p.s du dv

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRate_variable_duality_weighted
statement:
theorem complexionRate_variable_duality_weighted
    (u v du dv c s dc ds : ℝ) :
    complexionRate (u * c - v * s) (v * c + u * s)
        (variableDualityElectricDerivative u v du dv c s dc ds)
        (variableDualityMagneticDerivative u v du dv c s dc ds) =
      (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) * complexionRate c s dc ds +
        (c ^ 2 + s ^ 2) * complexionRate u v du dv

name: RainichKaluza.dualityParameter_derivative_eq_complexionRate
statement:
theorem dualityParameter_derivative_eq_complexionRate
    (c s dc ds : ℝ)
    (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (htangent : c * dc + s * ds = 0) :
    dc = -complexionRate c s dc ds * s ∧
      ds = complexionRate c s dc ds * c

name: RainichKaluza.duality_tangent_iff_existsUnique_complexionRate
statement:
theorem duality_tangent_iff_existsUnique_complexionRate
    (c s dc ds : ℝ) (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    c * dc + s * ds = 0 ↔
      ∃! omega : ℝ, dc = -omega * s ∧ ds = omega * c

name: RainichKaluza.gaugeCorrectedComplexionRate_invariant
statement:
theorem gaugeCorrectedComplexionRate_invariant
    (omega connection tau : ℝ) :
    gaugeCorrectedComplexionRate (omega + tau) (connection + tau) =
      gaugeCorrectedComplexionRate omega connection

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRateFromChannels_common_smul
statement:
theorem complexionRateFromChannels_common_smul
    (x1 x2 z1 z2 y1 y2 lambda : ℝ) (hlambda : lambda ≠ 0) :
    complexionRateFromChannels

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRateFromChannels_eq
statement:

    (h1 : x1 = omega * z1 + (a / 2) * y1)
    (h2 : x2 = omega * z2 + (a / 2) * y2) :
    complexionRateFromChannels x1 x2 z1 z2 y1 y2 = omega

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRateFromChannels_gauge_shift
statement:
theorem complexionRateFromChannels_gauge_shift
    (x1 x2 z1 z2 y1 y2 tau : ℝ)
    (hdet : complexionCouplingDet z1 z2 y1 y2 ≠ 0) :
    complexionRateFromChannels (x1 + tau * z1) (x2 + tau * z2)

      complexionRateFromChannels x1 x2 z1 z2 y1 y2 + tau

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRateFromChannels_neg_scalarSource
statement:
theorem complexionRateFromChannels_neg_scalarSource
    (x1 x2 z1 z2 y1 y2 : ℝ) :
    complexionRateFromChannels x1 x2 z1 z2 (-y1) (-y2) =
      complexionRateFromChannels x1 x2 z1 z2 y1 y2

name: RainichKaluza.complexionRate_channel_numerator
statement:
theorem complexionRate_channel_numerator
    (x1 x2 z1 z2 y1 y2 omega a : ℝ)
    (h1 : x1 = omega * z1 + (a / 2) * y1)
    (h2 : x2 = omega * z2 + (a / 2) * y2) :

      omega * complexionCouplingDet z1 z2 y1 y2

name: RainichKaluza.complexion_coupling_pair_unique
statement:
theorem complexion_coupling_pair_unique
    (x1 x2 z1 z2 y1 y2 omega a omega' a' : ℝ)
    (hdet : complexionCouplingDet z1 z2 y1 y2 ≠ 0)
    (h1 : x1 = omega * z1 + (a / 2) * y1)
    (h2 : x2 = omega * z2 + (a / 2) * y2)
    (h1' : x1 = omega' * z1 + (a' / 2) * y1)
    (h2' : x2 = omega' * z2 + (a' / 2) * y2) :
    omega = omega' ∧ a = a'

name: RainichKaluza.couplingFromComplexionChannels_common_smul
statement:
theorem couplingFromComplexionChannels_common_smul

name: RainichKaluza.adaptedMaxwellStressFiber_coordinates
statement:
theorem adaptedMaxwellStressFiber_coordinates
    (GInv L K F : Matrix4) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hKL : K * L = 1) (hLK : L * K = 1)
    (hmetric : L * GInv * Lᵀ = minkowskiMetric)
    (hF : Fᵀ = -F)
    (hstress : transportMixed L (matrixMaxwellStress GInv F) K =
      canonicalMaxwellResidual q) :
    canonicalStressFiberCosine q (transportTwoForm K F) ^ 2 +
          canonicalStressFiberSine q (transportTwoForm K F) ^ 2 = 1 ∧
      transportTwoForm K F =
        canonicalStressFiberCosine q (transportTwoForm K F) •
            canonicalMaxwellTwoForm (Real.sqrt (2 * q)) 0 +
          canonicalStressFiberSine q (transportTwoForm K F) •
            canonicalHodgeStar (Real.sqrt (2 * q)) 0

theorem secondSpectralReflection_commutes_with_Ricci (a b : ℝ) :
    secondSpectralReflection * complementaryRicciMatrix a b =
      complementaryRicciMatrix a b * secondSpectralReflection

name: RainichKaluza.secondSpectralReflection_conjugates

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructedAmplitudeADerivative_relation
statement:

    epsilonA * x *
      reconstructedAmplitudeADerivative epsilonA x a b qSq da db dqSq =

name: RainichKaluza.reconstructedDiagonalADerivative_relation
statement:
theorem reconstructedDiagonalADerivative_relation

    (da - db) * reconstructedDiagonalA a b qSq +
      (a - b) * reconstructedDiagonalADerivative a b qSq da db dqSq =
        2 * a * da - dqSq

      (b - a) * reconstructedDiagonalBDerivative a b qSq da db dqSq =
        2 * b * db - dqSq

name: RainichKaluza.projectorDerivative_eq_complement_blocks
statement:
theorem projectorDerivative_eq_complement_blocks
    (p dp : A) (hp : p * p = p)
    (hdiff : dp * p + p * dp = dp) :
    dp = (1 - p) * dp * p + p * dp * (1 - p)

name: RainichKaluza.projectorDerivative_eq_three_complement_blocks

name: RainichKaluza.spectralProjectorDerivative_fourBlock
statement:
theorem spectralProjectorDerivative_fourBlock
    (R dR p dp q r s : A) (a b c d da : ℝ)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (had : a ≠ d)
    (hp : p * p = p) (hsum : p + q + r + s = 1)
    (hqp : q * p = 0) (hrp : r * p = 0) (hsp : s * p = 0)
    (hpq : p * q = 0) (hpr : p * r = 0) (hps : p * s = 0)
    (hqR : q * R = b • q) (hrR : r * R = c • r)
    (hsR : s * R = d • s)
    (hRq : R * q = b • q) (hRr : R * r = c • r)
    (hRs : R * s = d • s)
    (hid : dp * p + p * dp = dp)
    (hleft : dR * p + R * dp = da • p + a • dp)
    (hright : dp * R + p * dR = da • p + a • dp) :
    dp =
      (a - b)⁻¹ • (q * dR * p) +
      (a - c)⁻¹ • (r * dR * p) +
      (a - d)⁻¹ • (s * dR * p) +
      (a - b)⁻¹ • (p * dR * q) +
      (a - c)⁻¹ • (p * dR * r) +
      (a - d)⁻¹ • (p * dR * s)

name: RainichKaluza.spectralProjectorDerivative_left
statement:
theorem spectralProjectorDerivative_left
    (R dR p dp q : A) (a b da : ℝ) (hab : a ≠ b)

    (hdiff : dR * p + R * dp = da • p + a • dp) :
    q * dp = (a - b)⁻¹ • (q * dR * p)

name: RainichKaluza.spectralProjectorDerivative_left_scaled
